ns2:course.label: Research Methods in Plant Sci
ns2:course.description: Lectures, discussions, demonstrations, and laboratory exercises dealing with methods and apparatus used in plant sciences research. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MS:Crop Sciences -UIUC, MS: FSHN (Online) -UIUC, MS: Agricultural Educ -UIUC, or MS:Nat Res Env Sci -UIUC.
